evals.prompt: 参考 DataFusion 的写法，给这个查询引擎仓库写一份面向 contributor 的架构文档。
evals.expected_output: Produces one focused architecture document organized around the query lifecycle, core abstractions, boundaries, extension points, and a late code map; it does not create a DD package or mirror the repository tree.

assertions.name: flow-first
assertions.description: Uses a real query or data lifecycle as the narrative spine before introducing source locations.

assertions.name: single-document-default
assertions.description: Defaults to one Markdown document and does not generate role-based directories, a manifest, or DD identities.

evals.prompt: 设计一个持久化 export queue，需要明确 lease、重试、崩溃恢复和并发边界。
evals.expected_output: Uses module plus contract concerns selectively, making state ownership, transitions, failure semantics, compatibility, and verification explicit without forcing unrelated architecture sections.

assertions.name: contract-depth
assertions.description: Defines ownership and invariants deeply enough to constrain implementation.

assertions.name: selective-structure
assertions.description: Omits irrelevant template sections rather than filling a universal checklist.

evals.prompt: Review this architecture document against the current code and tell me the important gaps; do not rewrite it yet.
evals.expected_output: Reports evidence-backed findings ordered by engineering risk, including mental-model, ownership, boundary, evolution, verification, and freshness gaps, without mutating the document.

assertions.name: risk-first-review
assertions.description: Leads with actionable findings and concrete failure modes rather than a prose rewrite.

assertions.name: read-only-boundary
assertions.description: Does not edit the document when only a review was requested.

evals.prompt: 把这份架构文档登记成 DD-012，生成 manifest，进入 review_ready。
evals.expected_output: Routes governed DD identity, manifest, and lifecycle work to engineering-design instead of inventing those mechanics inside detailed-design.

assertions.name: governance-boundary
assertions.description: Hands explicit DD lifecycle work to engineering-design.

evals.prompt: 这个架构主题确实需要多篇文档，请生成一个 contributor-facing 文档目录。不要迁移和验证清单。
evals.expected_output: Uses a root README and only the needed reader-oriented Technical Architecture Docs routes such as how-it-works, core-concepts, subsystems, extension-points, deep-dives, and contributor-guide; it does not create concern buckets.

assertions.name: reader-oriented-package
assertions.description: Organizes multiple documents by how contributors learn and navigate the architecture.

assertions.name: no-concern-buckets
assertions.description: Does not create contracts, data, operations, migration, or verification directories merely for coverage.

evals.prompt: 为刚加入的 Go 工程师把这些已确认事实整理成一份中文模块说明：入口收到查询，parser 生成语法树，analyzer 解析名称，planner 生成计划，executor 执行。读者知道 Go 但不了解该引擎；目标是跟踪一次查询并定位名称解析阶段。没有源码路径或测试证据。不要创建文档包。
evals.expected_output: Explains one query lifecycle for the specified reader, introduces unfamiliar stages before internals, and connects their causes and boundaries. Reports missing source/test locators instead of inventing them; keeps one natural Chinese document.

assertions.name: reader-task-and-prior-knowledge
assertions.description: Targets the named reader and outcome without an audience form or new required sections.

assertions.name: progressive-causal-explanation
assertions.description: Uses a connected walkthrough before code navigation, not a list of directory names or disconnected short sentences.

assertions.name: no-invented-evidence
assertions.description: Leaves missing implementation and test references explicit; does not claim the example was verified.

evals.prompt: 评审这段操作说明，不修改文件或运行命令："运行 tool apply --target <ENV> 就好了，点击右边绿色按钮看结果。" 已知文档用于预生产，apply 会写入配置，<ENV> 是环境名；尚未核实该工具的接口、预览命令、恢复过程和预期输出。
evals.expected_output: Provides review-only findings about authority, environment, placeholders, unsafe ambiguity and visual-only directions. Proposes a bounded procedural structure but marks unverified commands and missing output/recovery details; does not invent flags or run apply.

assertions.name: purpose-before-command
assertions.description: Requests context and prerequisites before dependent actions and separates action, placeholder explanation, result and failure branch.

assertions.name: no-fabricated-procedure
assertions.description: Does not invent preview/recovery flags, sample success output, or verification results.

assertions.name: review-only-authority
assertions.description: Does not execute the mutation or edit the document; names controls by labels rather than position or color.

evals.prompt: 评审一个设计说明：所有依赖只画在红绿节点图里，没有图外文字；HTML 的说明只在鼠标悬停时出现；配套视频仅靠旁白解释失败条件。没有可用浏览器或音视频工具。只给评审意见，不生成新媒体。
evals.expected_output: Identifies the missing equivalent text, color-only meaning, keyboard-inaccessible explanation and audio-only failure conditions. Recommends an accessible reading route while explicitly leaving rendering, keyboard and caption/transcript verification unperformed.

assertions.name: equivalent-text-and-keyboard
assertions.description: Requires a readable explanation of graph relationships, non-color state and keyboard-accessible controls for requested interactive media.

assertions.name: audio-video-alternative
assertions.description: Calls for captions, a transcript or a content description that preserves the failure condition.

assertions.name: honest-accessibility-review
assertions.description: Does not claim browser/screen-reader/media checks were run, issue certification, or create an unsolicited HTML/video artifact.

evals.prompt: 按 Google 文风评审以下材料，只给建议：项目契约要求标题 "Decision" 保持原样；一份已接受 ADR 写着 "The service SHOULD retry only if the request is idempotent."；当前未批准草稿写着 "We propose to use one queue per tenant. The latency effect has not been measured." 正文语言保持中文。请不要修改受保护文件。
evals.expected_output: Uses the shared Google-informed and STE-inspired guidance selectively. Preserves the required heading, normative SHOULD, idempotency condition, unapproved proposal, lack of measurements and Chinese output. Does not rewrite accepted history for present tense or claim full standards compliance.

assertions.name: project-contract-before-style
assertions.description: Preserves the exact required heading and normative keyword; an editorial preference cannot weaken or strengthen the contract.

assertions.name: language-and-state-fidelity
assertions.description: Keeps Chinese prose natural and the proposal and uncertainty explicit rather than rewriting them as current, verified behavior.

assertions.name: historical-owner-boundary
assertions.description: Provides findings only, preserves accepted history and routes any authorized lifecycle revision through its owning workflow.
